subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should this focused native Automations management scope, including the bundled Skills follow-up fixes, become the supported iOS and Android product boundary?
rationale: The canonical feature issue and this PR carry protected maintainer/product-direction signals, and code review cannot decide the intended native-versus-Control-UI boundary or whether the mixed Skills follow-up should land here.

options.title: Approve after targeted fix
options.body: Accept the proposed mobile management boundary and combined scope after the invalid-spec refresh defect is repaired and exact-head native checks complete.

options.title: Split the Skills follow-up
options.body: Keep Automations in this PR but move the unrelated Skills corrections into a narrowly scoped follow-up before final review.

options.title: Narrow mobile management
options.body: Retain fewer native mutation controls and leave more management behavior exclusively in the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted fix
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed mobile management boundary and combined scope after the invalid-spec refresh defect is repaired and exact-head native checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to both the canonical proposal and recent merged cross-platform native management work, though final authority may be shared with other native-app owners.
